newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae shares seen little moved by results.
newsitem.headline: Sonae shares seen little moved by results.

text.p: Shares in Sonae Investimentos, the retail to wood products holding, were expected to show little reaction to the group's first half figures even though they were slightly below the more optimistic expectations, traders said.

Sonae posted a consolidated net profit of 3.3 billion escudos for the first half against 2.4 billion, net of extraordinaries, in 1995. Its stock closed at 4,515 escudos on Monday ahead of the results.
Traders said that investors were concentrating more on the group's plans to split off its industrial activities and leave the holding with just the real estate, distribution and retail businesses.
"Whether the results were good or bad, I think that investors are more and more influenced by the split and the good prospects it will bring," said a share analyst at Lisbon's Gesfinc.
"We were not surprised by the results. They are reasonable and I think the share price should hold," said Joao Vermelho of Central de Investimentos.
